The '''Bellorin Medical Academy''' was a [[Nurse/Legends|nursing]] and [[Doctor/Legends|doctoral]] [[school]] and trained pupils as [[Medic/Legends|medics]] and healers.

[[Nadra Enasteri]] enrolled in this academy as a medic and a healer, but returned to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] after learning that her mother was ill.
